'''''The Cestus Deception''''' is a novel by [[Steven Barnes]] that was first published by [[Del Rey]] in hardcover on [[June 1]] [[2004]]. The first paperback edition was released in [[March]] [[2005]]. The book is part of the [[Clone Wars multimedia project]]. The novella ''[[The Hive]]'', also written by Barnes, serves as a tie-in to the novel. The [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] story from [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 46]], which first references [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]], is also included at the start of the book.
